survey-app-prototyping.question: Did you prototype or test the survey app with users before launch? If so, add how, and what changed. That would support the posting's prototyping and testing requirements.
survey-app-prototyping.answer: Yes. Touch screen tv in a conference room with only transportation department director and managers as an audience and the executive director giving the presentation. I gave the ED a minimal overview of the navigation, how the math works, and the results page. I observed the ED intently, looking at efficiency of movement, micro expressions of uncertainty or frustration, and felt the engagement energy of the room. Afterwards I shared my observations and refinement ideas with the ED who also gave me his feedback. I'd make the changes then do a stress test in the real presentation setting then refine on the spot.
